_comment: Single source of truth for diagnostic-machine bidding cases. Mirrors rl_gateway/cases.json for the bed family: add a modality = add a block in `cases`; add/point a participant = one line in `departments`. The loader (queries.py) derives keyword->modality matching, department->engine AgentKind, and agent-node->department from here. IMPORTANT DIFFERENCE FROM BEDS: `icu` is directly eligible on every diagnostic modality (verified against profiles.MODALITIES), so the F-12 icu->ward substitution the bed gateway performs does NOT apply here and must not be copied -- icu bids as icu. CT additionally admits `appointments`, the scheduled-outpatient bidder, which no other modality has and which has no agent node; it is driven by the scheduling system, not by a department. Machine inventory is NOT here -- it is tenant state, and lives in assemble.MACHINE_REGISTRY until a real equipment table exists.
